question: Geto Sora won the Arena Junior (Boys) International Badminton Championship. He belongs to which state?
solution:
The correct answer is **Arunachal Pradesh**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Geto Sora** is a young and talented badminton player from Arunachal Pradesh.
 
• He won the **Arena Junior (Boys) International Badminton Championship**, showcasing his exceptional skills.
 
• This achievement has brought recognition to his home state, **Arunachal Pradesh**.
 
• Badminton is gaining popularity in the northeastern states of India, with many young players emerging on the national and international scene.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Arunachal Pradesh** is a state in the northeastern part of India, known for its diverse culture and scenic beauty.
 
• The state has been producing many talented athletes in various sports, including **badminton**, archery, and football.
 
• **Badminton** is a popular sport in India, and the country has produced several world-class players like P.V. Sindhu and Saina Nehwal.
 
• The **Arena Junior International Badminton Championship** is a prestigious tournament that attracts young talent from around the world.
